en: A vintage, monochrome postcard view of a European town square. Along the left side are multi‑story townhouses with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. One bears a sign for the "Hotel zur goldnen Kugel." On the right stands a large church with a tall tower topped by an onion-shaped spire. The open square in the foreground is sparsely planted with young trees. At the top of the postcard, printed in red, is the caption "Grossenhain. Hauptmarkt."
